title: Nature Into Life
description: Life that you can turn into mobs and more and 4 new mobs.
body:
Nature into life is a mod, in which you can turn nature, like dirt into life. You first start with raw life, you can turn it into stained life. There are also recipes in which you can craft unobtainable blocks like mob spawners. This adds 3 new mobs and 1 new boss and a new weapon which is named the teeth wand. The teeth wand shoots burning teeth. You can get teeth by killing the life eater.

I was inspired by the mod dirt platform by Happy Fish.

Nature into life is available for forge and neoforge.

Why this mod?
I reccomend you this mod. If your bored of bringing animals to your farm, and want to craft the animals yourself, or maybe get unobtainable items and maybe get the new combat item.
